verdict.rationale: Anytype ships a local API inside the desktop app that runs on localhost and works offline. It also offers a CLI that runs Anytype as a headless server for automation and scripting, plus a gRPC API and an agents toolkit that can read, search and modify Objects programmatically. Together these satisfy the story's 'local endpoint' path for scripting workflows. Missing for 10: no evidence of a URI scheme or deep links for opening notes in the UI, no explicit documentation of creating notes through the endpoint, no published OpenAPI spec at the probed paths, and no independent hands-on corroboration.
